Here is the same move in a different setting. A box holds 60% of the parts from line A and 40% from line B. 10% of A's parts are faulty and 25% of B's are. Given a part is faulty, what is the chance it came from B? The definition says P(B|F) = P(B and F) / P(F). The top is the joint along B's path; the bottom is the total of all paths ending in F.
